extDescription.message: Opens your Hipcall web phone, lets you call numbers on any web page with one click (CTI) and keeps you reachable for calls.

closed.message: Hipcall web phone window closed, be aware that you can't receive calls when popup window closed.
closed.description: Notification when the web phone window is closed

tabNumbers.description: Popup tab listing the phones and e-mails found on the current page

nothingFound.message: No phone numbers or e-mails found on this page.

toastCallFailed.message: Hipcall: the call could not be sent. $REASON$

toastReloadPage.message: The Hipcall extension was updated. Please reload this page (F5).

autoDialHint.message: When off, the number is only typed into the dial pad and you start the call.

modeSelectedHint.message: Icons appear only on the listed pages. Default: home page.

modeAllHint.message: Icons appear on every page of the site; exclude the ones you don't want.

noIncludedPages.message: No pages selected — icons are off on this site.

noExcludedPages.message: No pages excluded — icons are on every page of this site.

patternHint.message: Tip: /blog/* matches /blog and every page below it.

regionSub.message: Choose the region your account belongs to.

emptyText.message: Open a website and click the extension again to find its numbers and e-mails.

callFailedText.message: $NUMBER$ could not be sent to Hipcall. Make sure you are signed in to Hipcall and try again.

menuCallSelection.description: Right-click menu on selected text; Chrome replaces %s with the selection

menuNoNumberText.message: The selected text has no number to call: “$TEXT$”

menuCallHere.description: Right-click menu on a link or the page (number under the cursor)

menuNoNumberHere.message: No number found where you right-clicked. Select the number and try again.

signinHint.message: Sign in with your Hipcall account to find contacts and companies and see your activities.

signinNotAvailable.message: Sign-in with Hipcall is only available for Türkiye accounts for now.

errSignedOut.message: Your session has ended, please sign in again.

errForbidden.message: You do not have access to this information.

findHint.message: Searches Hipcall contacts and companies by this page's numbers, e-mails and website.

findNeedsSignin.message: Sign in with your Hipcall account to search.

findSearched.message: Searched $1 numbers, $2 e-mails and the site $3.

findNothing.message: No matching contact or company in Hipcall.

activitiesNeedsSignin.message: Sign in with your Hipcall account to see your activities.

addCompany.message: Add to Hipcall as a company

companyAddHint.message: Details were filled in from this site. You can change, add or remove anything before saving.

needsWriteAccess.message: Adding companies needs write access. Please sign in again — your form is kept.

overLimit.message: Hipcall accepts at most $1 per company; this row will not be added.

limitOver.message: $1 found — the first $2 will be added

errNameShort.message: The company name must be at least 3 characters.

errInvalidScope.message: Hipcall does not allow this extension to add contacts/companies (contacts:write). It must be enabled on the Hipcall side.

signinTimeout.message: Sign-in timed out, please try again.

draftRestored.message: Signed in. Your form was restored — press "Add company" again.

errNotAdded.message: The company was not added. Please fix the following:

errRateLimited.message: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.

errNotFound.message: Hipcall could not find this record or address.

errServer.message: Hipcall cannot answer right now (server error). Try again in a few minutes.

errApi.message: Hipcall did not accept the request: $1

errSigninState.message: Sign-in could not be verified (security check). Please sign in again.

errToken.message: Sign-in could not be completed, Hipcall did not issue a session key ($1). Please try again.

vTaken.message: Another record already uses this value.

vPhone.message: Not a valid phone number. Check the number and the country code.

vNotInList.message: Not one of the allowed options.

vRange.message: The value is out of the allowed range.

vUnknownField.message: Hipcall does not know this custom field.

vInactive.message: This custom field is disabled in Hipcall.

customFieldsUnavailable.message: Could not load the custom fields from Hipcall ($1). Any required field will be shown here when you save.

liNotReadable.message: This LinkedIn page could not be read. Press refresh once the page has fully loaded.

liNoContactShared.message: This person shares no phone, e-mail or website on LinkedIn.

liPersonHint.message: Are this person and their company in Hipcall?
